testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect save-change prompt frequency choices ✔ Given the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates and finishes an empty sketch on the XY datum plane ✔ And the unsaved modified part is active ✔ And save-change prompts are configured to always show ✔ When the user closes the document tab ✔ And the user opens the prompt-frequency list ✔ Then the list offers always show, once per operation, suppress for this session and suppress permanently ✔ When the user dismisses the list without changing its selection ✔ And the user cancels the save-changes prompt ✔ Then the part remains active
